# AI Math Tutor

AI Math Tutor is a realtime voice tutor demo with a FastAPI WebSocket session backend, swappable STT/LLM/TTS providers, interruption-safe browser playback, lesson memory, and a visible avatar.

## Primary URLs

- Live app: https://aitutor.maxpetrusenko.com
- Tutor session: https://aitutor.maxpetrusenko.com/session
- Lesson catalog: https://aitutor.maxpetrusenko.com/lessons
- Avatar switcher: https://aitutor.maxpetrusenko.com/avatar
- Model settings: https://aitutor.maxpetrusenko.com/models
- Session API WebSocket: wss://aitutor-session.maxpetrusenko.com/ws/session

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/maxpetrusenko/ai-math-tutor
- Public README: https://github.com/maxpetrusenko/ai-math-tutor#readme

## Useful project facts

- Frontend: Next.js session UI, mic capture, transcript, playback, and avatar shell.
- Backend: FastAPI session state, turn boundaries, provider orchestration, and lesson persistence APIs.
- Tutor stack: Deepgram-compatible STT, Gemini/MiniMax/OpenAI/Anthropic LLM providers, Cartesia/MiniMax TTS, and a self-hosted TalkingHead avatar.
- Demo path: open /session, send a typed or spoken turn, continue a follow-up turn, inspect History, interrupt with Escape, then open /avatar.
